title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at 81,424—virtually flat on the day. Don't let that calm fool you. Fear index sitting at 46, still in fear territory, but we're stabilizing above that psychological threshold.

Here's what matters: hashrate is climbing. We're at 985.1 exahashes per second. That's network conviction talking. Miners aren't dumping—they're committing.

Mempool's running clean. 62,000 transactions queued, but fees are reasonable—5 sat per byte gets you through. No congestion
